d: ORMs map database tables to objects in your programming language. They speed up development and prevent SQL injection, but can introduce performance problems (N+1 queries). Know when to use raw SQL vs ORM.
c: ORM vs Query Builder vs Raw SQL
Active Record vs Data Mapper patterns

p: Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) tools map database rows to object-oriented classes in your code. They abstract away raw SQL, making DB interactions safer (prevents SQL injection) and easier to write.
2. ORM generates the underlying SQL tables (Migrations).
3. Use ORM methods like `User.find()` instead of `SELECT * FROM users`.
4. Warning: Complex queries can suffer the 'N+1 Query Problem'.

// Prisma ORM Example
const user = await prisma.user.create({
  data: {
    name: 'Alice',
    email: 'alice@example.com',
  },
});
